text: Phoebe starts at the architecture firm on Monday. She sounded excited but a bit daunted by the commute. Text her Monday evening to see how the first day went.
Chidi and Amy are expecting! Due in late March. Amy has had awful morning sickness, so she's mostly been living on crackers.
Ignacio has an interview with the council on Thursday for the planning officer role. He's really nervous about the presentation part. I should send him a good luck message Wednesday night.
Fang retires on 28 November after thirty-one years at the hospital. There's a do at the Crown that Friday. Need to chip in for the collection before then.

Lunch with Ali. His sister Zara has just had a baby girl, Nadia, born on Saturday. Ali is already calling himself the fun uncle and has bought her a tiny Fenerbahçe kit. Zara is staying with their parents for the first couple of weeks while her husband finishes a contract in Dubai. Ali reckons she'd love a visit once things calm down, maybe the weekend after next.
Damian didn't get the promotion. He's gutted and thinking about applying elsewhere. Check in with him next week.
Dmitri's leaving drinks are next Friday, 7pm at the Fox and Hounds. I'm going straight from work.
Ilse mentioned she's applying for a master's in Copenhagen. Deadline is 15/01. She's also learning Danish on Duolingo, which explains the sudden vocabulary.
Mabel's christening is on the 3rd of May at St Anne's. Saskia asked if I'd be a godparent! Must say yes properly, in writing, and think about a gift.
Juan got the job at the bike shop. Starts 2 Dec.
Abebe's wife Grace is due in a fortnight. He's on paternity leave from the 10th and says they still haven't painted the nursery. I'm dropping round a meal on Sunday so they don't have to cook.

Call from Mehmet. His dad is retiring from the bakery at the end of the month and Mehmet is taking it over. Big change for him, he sounded both proud and terrified. He's been doing the early shifts with his dad for years, but he's never done the accounts or dealt with suppliers. His wife Fang is going to help with the books on Tuesdays and Thursdays. I should pop in on the first Saturday and buy far too many pastries.
Gustavo has a second interview tomorrow at 10. Text him good luck first thing.
Jasmine (Jas) has handed in her notice. Last day is 21 October, then she's off travelling around Vietnam for three months before starting her new role in January.
Renew passport before the conference in March. Book the photo booth this weekend.

Kemal is struggling at his new job. The manager there sounds like a nightmare and he's barely sleeping. He keeps saying he should never have left the old place. His partner Ilse says he's stopped going to football too. Ring him on Saturday, and maybe invite him to the quiz next Tuesday to take his mind off it.
Rafael and his wife are expecting their second. Twelve-week scan was yesterday and everything looked fine.
Femi was made head of department! Takes over after half term. Send congratulations card.
Patrick's interview with the airline was cancelled, they've frozen hiring. He's now applying for a ground crew role instead, deadline Friday.

Kiara and her husband are flying out to Lagos on 12 December for her cousin's wedding, and she's going back to work on the 4th of January. She asked if I could feed their cat Biscuit while they're away.
Eva mentioned she'd love a decent coffee grinder. Good to know for her birthday in June.
Coffee with Adebayo. He's been at the bank for ten years now and still loves it. Lives in Peckham with his partner and two kids. Big Arsenal fan, obviously.
Noor had her baby! A boy, 3.2kg, born Tuesday night. Both doing well. Don't forget to send flowers to Noor and ask her mum when it's okay to visit.
Camila's first day as a teaching assistant went really well apparently. She said the kids are lovely but the staffroom politics are something else.
Dimitri Nowak from the old team is applying for the senior analyst post. He asked me to be a referee. Need to send my reference to HR by 5 November.
Siddharth has his citizenship interview on Wednesday morning, then flies to Delhi on Friday to see his grandmother, who's been unwell. Wish him luck Tuesday evening.

Ali's boss told him the whole team might be made redundant in the new year. He's trying to stay positive but you could tell he's worried. Consultation meeting is on 9th of January. His wife Saskia has just gone back to work after maternity leave, so the timing could hardly be worse. He's already quietly updating his LinkedIn and has a call with a recruiter on Monday. Meet Ali for lunch the week after the meeting.
Note to self: dentist on Thursday at 3:15, then pick up dry cleaning.
Phoebe's mum is retiring next spring and Phoebe is planning a surprise party for her. She wants ideas for venues.
Amy said Chidi has been super anxious about becoming a dad. He's reading every baby book going. Amy thinks it's sweet; I think he needs a pint. Take Chidi out for a drink this weekend.

Grace and Abebe's baby arrived early, on 2 Nov. A little girl called Liya. Abebe sent a photo, she's tiny. Need to get a card for both of them and something small for Liya. Grace had a rough time, an emergency C-section, and she's still in hospital until at least Wednesday. Abebe is running on no sleep and coffee. Ask him on Thursday whether they need anything from the shops.
Mabel is moving to Manchester for her new job at the BBC. She starts on 6 January and is viewing flats this weekend. Her boyfriend Emil is staying in Bristol for now, which she's not thrilled about.
Fang's daughter got into medical school. Fang is incredibly proud, couldn't stop talking about it.
Saskia has been vegan for a year now and is really into sourdough at the moment. She's also training for the Bath half marathon in March.
Message from Juan: first week at the bike shop done. He's loving it, though his hands are wrecked. Ask him on Friday whether he's settled on the full-time contract.

Long chat with Ilse tonight. She heard back from Copenhagen and has an online interview on 20th of November. She's nervous about the Danish language section, even though her Danish is honestly better than she thinks. Her brother Gustavo lives out there already, so she'd have somewhere to stay at first. Her partner Kemal is less keen on the move, they're still talking it through. I offered to do a practice interview with her next Sunday.
Ignacio didn't get the council job, but they've asked him to apply for the junior role that comes up in spring. He was surprisingly upbeat about it.
Dr Banerjee is leaving the practice at Christmas. Several of us want to do a card. Ask Noor if she's organising it.
Zara is back at work part-time from the 1st of February. She's worried about leaving Nadia at nursery for the first time.
Rafael's wife starts maternity leave on 14 March. He jokes that he's going to nest by reorganising the garage.
Need to update my CV and send it to the recruiter by Monday. Also chase the reference from the old job.
Uncle Damian is turning sixty on Saturday. Family meal at the Thai place at 7. I'm bringing the cake.

Femi and his wife Kiara just found out they're having twins! The scan was last Wednesday. They're thrilled and slightly panicking about the car, which apparently only fits one car seat. Femi has already started a spreadsheet of people carriers. Kiara is due in early June, which clashes with Femi's sister's wedding in Lisbon on the 7th, so that's going to be an interesting family conversation.
Patrick got the ground crew job. Starts training in Gatwick on 18/11.

Eva's leaving the charity after six years. Her last day is this Friday and then she's having a fortnight off before starting at the Wellcome Trust on Monday the 17th. She said she's sad to go but needed a change. Remind me to get her a leaving card and sign it from the book club too.
Siddharth's grandmother is doing better. He's back on Sunday.
Adebayo's son Tobi starts reception in September, they found out today he got their first-choice school. Adebayo was over the moon.
Jasmine sent a message from Hanoi. All good, she's eating her way round the city. No need to reply straight away.
Kemal said his boss finally left, so the job is much better now. He'd been stressed all autumn, but he says it's sorted. Also he's started climbing on Wednesday nights.
Camila's partner Dimitri has a job interview in Leeds on Tuesday. If he gets it they'll move up north in the summer. Camila doesn't want to leave her school. Ask Camila how it went on Wednesday.
Grace mentioned the christening for Liya will probably be in the spring, maybe April. Nothing booked yet.
Pick up the prescription and buy milk on the way home.
Noor's mum said visitors are fine from next Thursday. Noor is exhausted but happy. The baby is called Yusuf. Don't forget to bring the hamper we put together.
Mehmet officially took over the bakery on Monday. His dad still comes in every morning to 'check on the bread'. Mehmet says the croissants are his first big change.
Phoebe had her probation review on Friday and passed with flying colours. She's thinking about asking for a pay rise in the new year.

Chidi, aka Chi, has been offered a promotion to team lead but it means more travel, and with the baby coming he's not sure. He has to decide by the end of next week. I told him I'd call him on Thursday to talk it through.
Gustavo didn't get the job after the second interview. They said it was very close. He's taking a few days off and going walking in Wales this weekend with his dog Pablo.
Got a text from Abebe saying Liya is sleeping through, mostly. Grace has gone back to her Pilates class.
Amy's baby shower is on Saturday 14 March, hosted by her sister Ilse. The theme is 'garden party'. Amy said a nappy cake would go down well, or vouchers for the baby shop.
Fang's retirement party was lovely. Must post her the photos and the card everyone signed, since she left before we got to it.
